name: node test mock timers error codes and messages
source: import { mock } from 'node:test'; function main(): void { const out: string[] = []; const show = (label: string, f: () => unknown): void => { try { const r = f(); out.push(label + ' ok ' + (r === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(r))); } catch (e: any) { out.push(label + ' ' + e.name + ' ' + e.code + ' | ' + e.message); } }; show('tick before', (): void => mock.timers.tick(1)); show('setTime before', (): void => mock.timers.setTime(1)); show('runAll before', (): void => mock.timers.runAll()); show('reset before', (): void => mock.timers.reset()); show('enable bogus', (): void => mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['bogus'] as any })); mock.timers.reset(); show('enable apis str', (): void => mock.timers.enable({ apis: 'setTimeout' as any })); mock.timers.reset(); show('enable now str', (): void => mock.timers.enable({ now: 'abc' as any })); mock.timers.reset(); show('enable now neg', (): void => mock.timers.enable({ now: -1 })); mock.timers.reset(); show('enable now NaN', (): void => mock.timers.enable({ now: NaN })); mock.timers.reset(); mock.timers.enable({ now: 5 }); show('tick -1', (): void => mock.timers.tick(-1)); show('setTime -1', (): void => mock.timers.setTime(-1)); show('setTime str', (): void => mock.timers.setTime('x' as any)); show('tick 1.5', (): number => { mock.timers.tick(1.5); return Date.now(); }); mock.timers.reset(); show('enable twice', (): void => { mock.timers.enable(); mock.timers.enable(); }); mock.timers.reset(); show('tick after reset', (): void => mock.timers.tick(1)); console.log(out.join('|')); }
